fsn.title: Urgent: Infusomat Space administration set occlusion alarm failure
fsn.raw_content: Affected products: Infusomat Space Line administration sets REF 8713060 8713061. The occlusion alarm may not trigger under specific back-pressure conditions.

fsn.title: MAUDE adverse event: INFUSOMAT SPACE infusion pump over-delivery
fsn.raw_content: Event narrative: The pump reportedly delivered medication at a higher rate than programmed. Device brand name: INFUSOMAT SPACE. Generic name: pump, infusion. Patient outcome: hospitalization.

fsn.title: Sicherheitsinformation zu Straumann BLX Implantatsystem von Straumann AG
fsn.raw_content:
BfArM reference: 33445/26
Betroffene Produkte: Straumann BLX Dentalimplantate. Chargenrueckruf wegen Verpackungsfehler.

fsn.title: Field Safety Notice: Elecsys Troponin T assay calibration drift
fsn.raw_content: Affected products: Elecsys Troponin T Gen 5 immunoassay reagent lots. Laboratory IVD product. Recalibration required.

fsn.title: Field Safety Notice: Codan infusion administration sets leakage
fsn.raw_content: Affected products: Codan V86 infusion administration sets, compatible with common volumetric infusion pumps. Potential leakage at the pump segment under high flow rates.

fsn.title: Safety notice: RadPlan RT dose planning software calculation error
fsn.raw_content: Affected products: RadPlan RT radiotherapy treatment planning software v9.2. Incorrect dose distribution rendering in specific beam configurations.
